title: incident-bot: on-call diagnostics helpers + SLO toolkit integration (enhancement)
author: Priya Malhotra
body: Summary: Add a small library of on-call diagnostics helpers to the incident-bot and integrate those helpers with the SLO toolkit runbook suggestions. The goal is to surface contextual diagnostics (recent SLO regressions, relevant traces, and quick KV cache checks) directly in on-call messages and runbook links so responders get high-signal context without navigating multiple tools. Motivation: During recent incidents we observed repeated hand-offs where responders spent 5-10 minutes collecting baseline telemetry (SLO trend, recent regressions, common error traces). This PR bundles lightweight helpers + a CLI/handler integration to reduce mean time to awareness (MTTA) and speed initial remediation. Changes: - incident_bot/diagnostics/helpers.py: new helpers to fetch recent SLO window summaries, top error traces, and quick topology hints. Helpers are intentionally read-only and use existing SLO toolkit APIs. - incident_bot/handlers/oncall_notify.py: wire diagnostics helpers into the on-call notification payloads as optional attachments when a runbook or SLO alert is present. - slo_toolkit/runbook_templates/diagnostics.md: new compact diagnostics template surfaced in runbook links. - incident_bot/cli/diagnostics_cmd.py: a small CLI (used by SRE and on-call) to run the same helpers ad-hoc for an incident channel. - tests/: unit tests for helper functions and end-to-end integration test for handler formatting. - docs/oncall/diagnostics.md: short doc with examples and guidance on when to enable extended diagnostics. Checklist: - [x] Add helper library with unit tests - [x] Integrate into on-call handler with feature flag - [x] Add runbook template and CLI command - [x] Update docs and add example alert payload - [x] Run e2e integration test in staging - [x] Validate CI and fix linting / type issues Compatibility/migration: This is non-breaking and behind feature flag incident_bot.diagnostics.enabled=false by default. Operators can enable per-team via configuration. Implementation notes: - Helpers call the SLO toolkit read APIs and cache short-lived responses (30s) to avoid spamming telemetry backends during high-volume incidents. - The diagnostics payload is capped at ~2KB when attached to on-call messages; full links to the runbook host provide the expanded context. - Rate-limiting/backoff is applied to all telemetry calls; aggressive retries were removed to avoid amplification during outages. Testing: Unit tests added and run locally. Staging e2e exercised with synthetic SLO alerts; CI initially failed on a flake in integration test (timeout on telemetry mock) — fixed by extending the test timeout and improving mock stability. Rollout plan: Merge to main behind feature flag, enable for the SRE team for 48h, collect on-call feedback, then enable broader teams. Rollback: disable feature flag to remove diagnostic attachments immediately. Related: ENG-7521 (oncall tooling improvements), SRE-130 (runbook ergonomics).
commits: helpers: add SLO and tracing diagnostics utilities
handlers: attach diagnostics payload to oncall notifications (behind flag)
cli: add diagnostics command for ad-hoc checks
tests: unit + e2e for diagnostics integration
review_comments: Liam O'Connor (2025-11-21): Overall looks good; can you add a short TTL for cached SLO summaries? Suggest 30s to start.
Priya Malhotra (2025-11-21): Added ttl param and defaulted to 30s. Updated tests to cover caching behavior.
Aisha Khan (2025-11-22): Minor nit: make sure CLI errors are user-friendly when telemetry backend returns 5xx. Please add a retry/backoff message.
Priya Malhotra (2025-11-22): Added clearer CLI error messages and exponential backoff with capped retries.
Victor Chen (2025-11-23): Unit tests look good. Found one flaky integration assertion—timeout still happening on slow CI runners. Increase test timeout and add retry on mock flakiness.
Priya Malhotra (2025-11-24): Increased e2e timeout and added retry for the mock; CI passed on rerun.
Liam O'Connor (2025-11-25): Approved. Good to ship behind flag.
ci_log_summary: CI run 3 (2025-11-24): all checks passed (lint, unit tests, integration)
release_notes: - Added on-call diagnostics helpers to incident-bot and integrated compact diagnostics into SLO toolkit runbook templates. Feature is off by default and can be enabled per-team via incident_bot.diagnostics.enabled. Includes a CLI for ad-hoc diagnostics.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative—read-only telemetry calls, short cache TTLs, and payload size limits to reduce blast radius. Plan is to gather SRE feedback during a limited rollout before enabling globally.
